subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should main-session automatic recovery use a cumulative three-accepted-attempt budget across arbitrary reboot gaps until successful progress resets it?
rationale: This prevents slow systemd or cron restart loops, but deliberately gives existing persisted sessions finite automatic recovery capacity across long intervals.

options.title: Approve cumulative budget
options.body: Keep three accepted attempts across reboot gaps and reset only after successful completion or normal user progress.

options.title: Use a time-windowed budget
options.body: Expire attempts after a chosen interval, preserving more recovery opportunities but leaving slow restart loops unbounded.

recommendation.title: Approve cumulative budget
recommendation.body: Keep three accepted attempts across reboot gaps and reset only after successful completion or normal user progress.
